study: pretrained external detector, zero target-domain fitting
selection: One fixed checkpoint per language; no target-corpus threshold or posterior calibration.

english.class1_definition: Fake at index 0; positive means model predicts machine generation.

arabic.class1_definition: AI at index 1 per publisher model_info and explicit model-card prediction code.

windows: 254 content wordpieces plus two special markers, 192 stride, anchored final window, native tokenizer, all content included. Empty-token input alone abstains. Use adjacent-center midpoint partitions over all wordpieces to weight per-window softmax P(machine) in document mean. Fixed inclusive threshold >=0.5; no parameter selection. Segment values are window evidence in Unicode code-point offsets, not sentence probabilities.
